module: Node "AI Go To The End Line" (color ai, duration behavior, no category). Sends a vehicle in "manual" AI mode to a finish line given by a position, and activates the flow output when it is within checkDistance (1 m by default) and slower than checkVelocity. Inputs: flow, reset, aiVehId, endLinePosition (vec3, hidden), checkDistance (hidden), checkVelocity (0.1, hidden). Outputs: flow, distance (hidden). Data: autoDisableOnArrive (true).
notes: Bug: the code writes self.pinOut.inRadius.value while the inRadius pin does not exist in pinSchema: the access would raise an error as soon as the vehicle is within the radius.
Unlike AI Arrive, no ai.setTarget command is sent: manual mode is enabled without a target, so this node does not really steer the vehicle toward endLinePosition.
The description of the output flow pin contains a typo ("slowe").

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

onNodeReset.desc: Resets complete and sentCommand to false.

getVeh.desc: Returns the vehicle whose id is given as input, or the player's vehicle (getPlayerVehicle(0)) without input.

work.desc: Handles reset; if already arrived, activates flow. Otherwise computes the distance between the middle of the vehicle's front and endLinePosition, determines arrival (distance and speed) and disables the AI if autoDisableOnArrive; sends ai.setState manual once. Node error if no position is given.
